digest.component_or_area: ruff linter configuration and codebase-wide ARG (unused argument) remediation
propositions: 72 ARG violations (56 ARG001, 14 ARG002, 2 ARG005) detected in src/rebar due to missing ARG family in pyproject.toml select clause

Cluster-1 reconciler leaf handlers (10 sites across apply_inbound/apply_outbound) have unused parameters dispatched via typed_dispatch.py that are unsafe to rename due to keyword passing and runtime string introspection
Cluster-2 OutboundMapper Protocol implementations (7 sites) have ARG violations from Protocol-pinned parameter names passed by keyword, requiring # noqa rather than rename

Rename-unsafe parameters (keyword-passed, string-referenced, or keyword-only) must carry noqa with justification rather than underscores, but RUF100 enabled in pyproject creates a landmine where noqa itself becomes an unused-noqa warning
One-off mechanical sweep conducted with no permanent ARG gate enabled in pyproject.toml; post-sweep baseline (21 residual violations) documented for future janitor runs to reassess gate enablement
